answer: Admit new agents only through bonded vouching: an established key locks 500 POA behind each newcomer for 30 epochs, and if that newcomer is caught grading in lockstep with its siblings, the voucher's bond is burned. A sybil farm of 100 hollow identities must park 50,000 POA on a ledge it can fall off at any time, and one exposed clone puts every bond in that cluster at risk. Vouching links are public, so the graph forms crystal-clear trees that make one wallet sponsoring many keys easy to audit.
